scope: treatment-side analytical taxonomy and repository-bounded candidate census

status_definitions.INCLUDED--CORE: selected before the external admission rule; no retroactive pass claim
status_definitions.PASS--EXTERNAL: passed the six-condition historical external admission rule
status_definitions.FAIL--SCOPE: known failure of the historical AI-construct scope condition
status_definitions.PENDING--INSTANTIATION: primary source characterized in a dated repository audit, but no candidate-specific local score/mapping/support/admission audit
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED--LOCAL: insufficient verified primary-source-and-data record in the repository
status_definitions.CONTROL/COMPARATOR: instantiated but not an AI-exposure candidate

six_score_dependence.interpretation: dependence diagnostic only; not latent-variable validation

limitations: The census is bounded by the dated, already verified repository record.
No global count of published occupation-level AI-exposure measures is claimed.
PASS denotes historical operational admissibility, not construct validity or truth.
Candidates without a local score, mapping, support, and admission audit remain pending or unverified rather than failed.
